query: Across Type of Traveller and Class, which review themes are associated with higher vs. lower Overall Rating?

per_column.name: seat_comfort_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag gives a groupable axis for the query; values match source (seat mentions correctly flagged in samples).

per_column.name: staff_service_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Useful theme axis; sample rows correctly flag crew/service mentions.

per_column.name: food_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Relevant theme flag; consistently correct across samples.

per_column.name: entertainment_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Good theme axis, but row 4 flagged 1 with no entertainment mention in text (food/crew/lighting only) — an unsupported assertion.

per_column.name: value_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Distinct theme; samples correctly 0 where value/price not discussed.

per_column.name: punctuality_mentioned
per_column.rationale: Useful theme; row 1 flagged 1 though text only says short flight, no punctuality claim — weak support.

per_column.name: cleanliness_mentioned
per_column.rationale: New theme axis; sample flags align with 'sanitized/clean' mentions.

per_column.name: review_length
per_column.rationale: Raw character count is generic and adds little leverage for theme-vs-rating; also values are inconsistent (e.g. 467 vs 991 vs 196 don't cleanly match text lengths, some mismatch).

per_column.name: detailed_negative_review
per_column.rationale: Sentiment+detail flag has some value but is near a bare negative-sentiment flag; row 2 clearly negative yet flagged 0, weakening reliability.

per_column.name: detailed_positive_review
per_column.rationale: Positive-detail flag useful as a coarse axis; sample values reasonable.

per_column.name: dominant_theme
per_column.rationale: Single dominant theme is a strong grouping axis, but assignment is questionable: food-centric rows 3 and 4 both labelled staff_service, not clearly warranted.

per_column.name: theme_count
per_column.rationale: Breadth-of-review measure gives a modelling axis; counts roughly track the flags, minor inconsistencies.

judge.rationale: The per-theme mention flags and dominant_theme/theme_count give genuine new axes directly aligned with the query about themes vs Overall Rating across Traveller/Class, so table-level usefulness is solid (review_length is a weak generic exception). Groundedness is generally sound extraction, but several samples show unsupported or mis-assigned values (entertainment flagged where absent, dominant_theme labelling food-heavy reviews as staff_service, punctuality flagged without support), pulling groundedness below the usefulness.
